data.title: Saudi Dodgeball National Team Announces Participation in 2026 World Championship in Bangkok
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Saudi Dodgeball Federation has announced the national team roster for the 11th World Dodgeball Championship, scheduled for December 7 to 12 in Bangkok, Thailand, with 1,400 male and female athletes representing 36 national teams.
    President of the Saudi Dodgeball Federation and Vice President of the World Dodgeball Association Prince Saud bin Abdulaziz bin Mohammed said the Saudi national team's participation in the world championship reflects the unlimited support provided to the sports sector by the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's leadership and the continuous follow-up of Minister of Sport Prince Abdulaziz bin Turki bin Faisal, in line with Saudi Vision 2030 objectives to promote sporting diversity and develop world-class athletes across various sports.
    He explained that the participation is the result of institutional efforts and sustained work by the Saudi Dodgeball Federation to ensure a strong representation of Saudi sports on the international stage, expressing his best wishes to the male and female athletes for success at the championship.
    The Saudi national team's participation follows a series of notable continental achievements in recent years, during which the team secured four Asian medals, including silver at the 2025 Asian Cup, silver in the youth competition at the 2024 Asian Championship, and bronze medals in the women's and junior competitions at the same championship.
    -- SPA
